forWhat: Every class at once: where each class's newest assessment stands, answers waiting too long, papers not back, and children who are {colour:red} in more than one subject.

layout.shows: Its newest assessment and where its papers stand.
Answers waiting for a person over {t:across.check_overdue_hours} hours after their paper was read, with [[Check them]].
Papers given over {t:across.papers_missing_days} days ago that have not come back.

layout.area: Needing help in more than one subject
layout.shows: Each child who is {colour:red} in more than one subject, linked to their page.

jobs.title: Clear what is overdue
steps: Under [[Checks overdue]], press [[Check them]] for each class.
Under [[Papers not back]], find the papers still with the children.

buttons.label: Check them
buttons.does: Opens that class's answers waiting for a person.
